what: LLM-Assisted Screening and Data Extraction for Living Systematic Reviews
title: LLM-Assisted Screening and Data Extraction for Living Systematic Reviews
text: LLM-assisted screening data extraction living systematic reviews managed metawoRld. Find: search PubMed look DOIs/PMIDs; titles structured abstracts fetched PubMed, Crossref fallback. Screen: title/abstract decisions project’s criteria, using LLM supported ellmer (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, local models, …). Run requests parallel, provider batch APIs half price. Extract: structured data full texts (PDF, text, HTML JATS XML) following project’s schema, validated anything stored. Review: Shiny apps check, correct override LLM output. Reproduce: every result cached project model, token use, cost fingerprint prompt, schema criteria. Re-runs process new outdated work; manual decisions never overwritten. Prompts, schemas criteria files metawoRld project, can edit .

title: LLM-Assisted Screening and Data Extraction for Living Systematic Reviews
text: Set LLM provider’s API key (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY GOOGLE_API_KEY) .Renviron. Optionally set DATAFINDR_EMAIL NCBI_API_KEY faster, polite PubMed access.
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("andjar/DataFindR")   # also installs metawoRld

title: LLM-Assisted Screening and Data Extraction for Living Systematic Reviews
code: library(metawoRld) library(DataFindR)  create_metawoRld("my_review", "Biomarker X in pregnancy",                  "Living review of maternal serum levels of X.",                  inclusion_criteria = c("Human pregnancy", "Serum or plasma X reported"),                  exclusion_criteria = c("Animal study", "Review or case report"))  # 1. Records (re-run regularly; only new records are fetched) hits <- df_search_pubmed('"biomarker X" AND pregnancy', "my_review")  # 2. Screening chat <- ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4.1-mini") screen <- df_assess_batch(chat, hits$identifier, "my_review")   # mode = "batch" for half price df_shiny_assess("my_review", chat)                               # check borderline cases  # 3. Extraction: put full texts in my_review/fulltext/ named df_fulltext_filename(id) df_pending_extraction("my_review") df_extract_batch(ellmer::chat_anthropic(), "my_review/fulltext", "my_review") df_shiny_extract("my_review", fulltext_dir = "my_review/fulltext")  # 4. Import into the metawoRld project and follow progress df_import_batch(metawoRld_path = "my_review") df_status("my_review") df_prisma_counts("my_review")

title: LLM-Assisted Screening and Data Extraction for Living Systematic Reviews
text: LLM output can wrong. Treat screening decisions extracted values suggestions verified; Shiny apps source field recorded data point make quick.

what: DataFindR: LLM-assisted screening and data extraction for metawoRld projects — DataFindR-package
title: DataFindR: LLM-assisted screening and data extraction for metawoRld projects — DataFindR-package
text: Typical workflow: df_search_pubmed() (df_fetch_metadata() / df_add_metadata()) collects records caches titles abstracts. df_assess_batch() screens project's criteria; df_shiny_assess() lets review override decisions. df_extract_batch() extracts data full texts included studies; df_shiny_extract() lets check correct results. df_import_batch() validates stores studies metawoRld project. df_status() df_prisma_counts() show progress.
